nodes.label: HistoricalContext Model
nodes.rationale: Pydantic model with sections (title/content/source_quotes) and optional timeline. Replaces plain str field in AnalysisResult.

nodes.label: StudyGuide Model
nodes.rationale: Pydantic model with concepts (ConceptGuide: concept/definition/stakes/exam_trap/source_quotes). Replaces plain str in AnalysisResult.

nodes.label: HistoryAgent
nodes.rationale: LLM agent that generates HistoricalContext from metadata and raw_text using json_mode=True. Falls back to flat analysis on parse failure.

nodes.label: ExamAgent
nodes.rationale: LLM agent that generates StudyGuide from metadata, concepts, and raw_text using json_mode=True. Falls back to single concept on parse failure.
